_readme: Templates for hosted endpoints and subscription plans. Everything here was read from the vendor's own docs or a docs aggregator on 2026-10-07 and is marked with its source; nothing was exercised against a live account (no keys on the dev machine). Hutch never stores a key in this file or the database: a key comes from an environment variable or a 0600 file under the state dir. Model protocols differ per model on some plans - override them per connection.

opencode-go.title: OpenCode Go (flat subscription)
opencode-go.signin_guidance: Open the OpenCode Console, sign in and subscribe to Go if needed, then copy its API key into Hutch. This is an API-key connection, not the full OpenCode assistant sign-in. For the complete OpenCode agent, use the OpenCode setup instead.

terms.notice: OpenCode Go asks third-party clients to send 'typical coding agent traffic', to identify themselves with their own User-Agent, and to send a stable session id; it says traffic is monitored for abuse. Hutch sends its own User-Agent and reuses a conversation id across runs in a conversation; standalone scheduled runs use their run id. Whether UNATTENDED, SCHEDULED bot runs count as typical coding-agent traffic is OpenCode's call, not Hutch's - read their terms before scheduling bots on this plan, and keep an allowance below so you stop before they do.

opencode-go.quota_hint: Usage is capped as monthly dollar amounts with a 5-hour sub-limit of 20% and a weekly sub-limit of 50% (docs, 2026-10-07). The dollar value per token varies by model, so declare your allowance in tokens (a rough proxy) and calibrate it against the OpenCode console.
opencode-go.model_protocol_hint: OpenCode Go serves chat at .../go/openai/v1 and .../go/anthropic, but the model catalogue lives at .../go/v1/models, which is why this template declares a separate catalogue URL. The vendor lists a native API per model: GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, Step and the free models speak OpenAI Chat Completions; Claude Haiku, MiniMax M3, Qwen3.8 and Qwen3.7 speak Anthropic Messages; Gemini 4 Argon speaks Gemini; Grok, GPT Luna and Muse Spark speak OpenAI Responses, which Hutch does not offer on a generic connection. Set a model's protocol with `hutch connections set-protocol <name> <model> anthropic` when it is not Chat Completions.

openai-api.title: OpenAI API
openai-api.setup_description: Connect an OpenAI API account. This is separate from a ChatGPT sign-in or subscription.
openai-api.quota_hint: OpenAI API usage is billed to the API account. Hutch records provider-reported usage, but configured token allowances are estimates and not provider-enforced currency caps.

anthropic-api.title: Anthropic API
anthropic-api.setup_description: Connect an Anthropic API account. Models are read from this account's live catalog.
anthropic-api.quota_hint: Anthropic API usage is billed to the API account. Hutch records provider-reported usage where available; estimates do not cap provider charges.

google-gemini.title: Google Gemini API
google-gemini.setup_description: Connect a Gemini API account from Google AI Studio. Models are read from this account's live catalog. Vertex AI is a separate catalogue identity, and a consumer Gemini sign-in is not an API key.
google-gemini.quota_hint: Gemini API usage is billed to the API account behind the key. Hutch records provider-reported token counts, but configured token allowances are estimates, not provider-enforced currency caps. Free-tier quotas and paid-tier limits differ by model.
google-gemini.model_protocol_hint: This route speaks the native Gemini generateContent protocol. Image input is sent inline; a remote image URL is refused rather than fetched. Thinking stays at the model default, and a per-turn effort maps to thinkingLevel only on Gemini 3 and later.

chatgpt-plan.title: ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT preview)

terms.notice: Experimental preview. Availability depends on OpenAI's eligibility and account controls. Hutch uses the official local Sign in with ChatGPT flow and sends Responses API requests with storage disabled and streaming enabled. This preview does not let Hutch set a provider-enforced output-token limit; Hutch's usage reservations and allowances are estimates, not hard spending caps.

chatgpt-plan.quota_hint: ChatGPT account usage is controlled by OpenAI. Hutch's token allowance is an admission estimate; the Responses preview omits output-token limits, so it cannot guarantee a per-response ceiling.
chatgpt-plan.model_protocol_hint: This route is fixed to OpenAI's Responses API and cannot be changed to Chat Completions or a custom endpoint.

xiaomi-token-plan-sgp.title: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan - Singapore (subscription credits)

terms.notice: The Token Plan is sold as a subscription of Credits for individual developers (keys start with tp-). Xiaomi documents support for coding tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code and OpenClaw; it does not say that unattended agent platforms are covered. Plans may be restricted to the listed tools and keys must not be shared. Hutch could not read the plan's full terms (the page is not machine-readable), so confirm yours allow automated use before scheduling bots on it.

xiaomi-token-plan-sgp.quota_hint: Credits, not tokens, are the unit and each model consumes them at a rate Xiaomi sets. Declare an allowance in tokens as a proxy and calibrate against your usage page in the Xiaomi console.

xiaomi-token-plan-cn.title: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan - China (subscription credits)

terms.notice: Same Token Plan terms as the Singapore endpoint: confirm that automated, unattended use is allowed on your plan before scheduling bots.

xiaomi-token-plan-cn.quota_hint: Credits, not tokens, are the unit; declare a token allowance as a rough proxy.

xiaomi-token-plan-ams.title: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan - Amsterdam (subscription credits)

terms.notice: Same Token Plan terms as the Singapore endpoint: confirm that automated, unattended use is allowed on your plan before scheduling bots.

xiaomi-token-plan-ams.quota_hint: Credits, not tokens, are the unit; declare a token allowance as a rough proxy.

xiaomi.title: Xiaomi MiMo - pay as you go (per token)
xiaomi.quota_hint: Per-token billing needs a price row in prices.json (Settings > Prices) before Hutch can estimate currency use; provider billing can differ.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.setup_description: One API key reaches a live catalog from multiple model providers. Model routing and final price can depend on upstream availability.
openrouter.quota_hint: OpenRouter prices vary by model and can change. Hutch shows the provider's catalog price, but currency-limited admission requires a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices. Hutch token allowances are separate estimates.
openrouter.model_protocol_hint: OpenRouter model ids come from its authenticated catalog. Chat Completions and tool support vary by model and upstream provider; the catalog does not prove a model will work for every task.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek
deepseek.quota_hint: Per-token billing. Add a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices before relying on currency admission; provider billing remains authoritative.
deepseek.model_protocol_hint: DeepSeek serves an OpenAI-shaped chat API. The vendor states legacy model names are re-pointed to the current served model with the same calling method, so record the model reported in responses.

custom-openai.title: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
custom-openai.quota_hint: Any server exposing /v1/chat/completions: OpenRouter, Together, Groq, DeepInfra, a company gateway, vLLM. Add a price row for per-token billing, or choose 'subscription' if it is flat-rate.

custom-anthropic.title: Custom Anthropic-compatible endpoint
custom-anthropic.quota_hint: Any server exposing /v1/messages. The URL is the root WITHOUT /v1/messages (the Anthropic SDK appends it).

mistral.title: Mistral
mistral.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
mistral.model_protocol_hint: Mistral's OpenAI-compatible chat route. Its embeddings and audio models use separate endpoints.

xai.title: xAI
xai.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
xai.model_protocol_hint: API-key route only. The X subscription / Grok consumer login is a first-party seat, not an API credential, and is not implemented here.

minimax.title: MiniMax
minimax.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
minimax.model_protocol_hint: This is the API-key (PAYG) route. The M Plan subscription key is a different billing relationship and is not this template.

moonshot.title: Moonshot / Kimi
moonshot.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
moonshot.model_protocol_hint: Overseas host. The China host is api.moonshot.cn and a key from one region is not used on the other. Kimi Code membership keys use a different base URL and are not this template.

zai.title: Z.AI
zai.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
zai.model_protocol_hint: Standard PAYG key. The GLM Coding Plan key is a separate route limited to its supported tools.

cohere.title: Cohere
cohere.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
cohere.model_protocol_hint: Cohere's Compatibility API accepts an OpenAI-shaped chat request; not every OpenAI field or tool shape is guaranteed.

stepfun.title: StepFun
stepfun.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
stepfun.model_protocol_hint: China host. The global host is api.stepfun.ai and keys are matched to their region. Step Plan uses a different path and is not this template.

groq.title: Groq
groq.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
groq.model_protocol_hint: Groq's OpenAI-compatible surface. Tool and audio support vary by model rather than by endpoint.

cerebras.title: Cerebras
cerebras.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
cerebras.model_protocol_hint: Cerebras' OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Hutch does not assume every OpenAI parameter is supported.

fireworks.title: Fireworks
fireworks.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
fireworks.model_protocol_hint: Fireworks offers OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility; this template uses the OpenAI-shaped path.

together.title: Together AI
together.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
together.model_protocol_hint: Model ids and prices come from Together's own catalog; per-model features vary.

deepinfra.title: DeepInfra
deepinfra.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
deepinfra.model_protocol_hint: The public model list does not prove a model accepts tools, images or a given context length.

novita.title: NovitaAI
novita.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
novita.model_protocol_hint: The catalog lists many models and per-model features vary.

chutes.title: Chutes
chutes.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
chutes.model_protocol_hint: Chutes bills in its own credit units; Hutch does not convert those to currency. The vendor also documents an OAuth browser flow, which this API-key template does not implement.

nvidia.title: NVIDIA
nvidia.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
nvidia.model_protocol_hint: The hosted NIM catalog is reachable with an nvapi- key; Hutch does not translate NVIDIA's hosted tiers into a currency price.

huggingface.title: Hugging Face Inference
huggingface.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
huggingface.model_protocol_hint: The HF router forwards to third-party inference providers. One token reaches them, but the serving provider and its price can differ per model.

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
synthetic.model_protocol_hint: syn: aliases route to an upstream model; Hutch records the model the provider reports back.

venice.title: Venice
venice.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
venice.model_protocol_hint: Venice exposes an OpenAI-compatible surface with private/anonymized modes. Its plan and X402 billing are not modeled by Hutch's currency admission.

gmi-cloud.title: GMI Cloud
gmi-cloud.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
gmi-cloud.model_protocol_hint: Multi-organization keys can require an X-Organization-ID header, which this template does not set.

arcee.title: Arcee
arcee.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
arcee.model_protocol_hint: The same models are also reachable through OpenRouter with an OpenRouter key; that is a different billing account.

ollama-cloud.title: Ollama Cloud
ollama-cloud.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
ollama-cloud.model_protocol_hint: Hosted service, not local inference: a cloud model is billed and labelled as hosted even though the same model name may also run locally.

volcengine.title: Volcengine (Doubao/ARK)
volcengine.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
volcengine.model_protocol_hint: ARK model ids are the account's own endpoint/model ids. The data-plane URL is not interchangeable with the control plane or the Coding Plan URL.

tencent-cloud.title: Tencent Cloud TokenHub
tencent-cloud.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
tencent-cloud.model_protocol_hint: Region-scoped: a key is valid only on its own TokenHub site, and no cross-region or cross-site call is made. TokenPlan uses a different base URL and is not this template.

kilocode.title: Kilocode / Kilo Gateway
kilocode.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
kilocode.model_protocol_hint: Kilo Gateway is a router billed in Kilo credits. The upstream model and price can change per request, so Hutch records the model the gateway reports.

byteplus.title: BytePlus ModelArk
byteplus.quota_hint: Per-token billing on the provider account. Hutch's currency admission needs a reviewed price row in Settings > Prices; the provider's own billing remains authoritative.
byteplus.model_protocol_hint: BytePlus ModelArk is the international ARK sibling; its region base URL is not interchangeable with Volcengine's.
